user_prompt: My landlord hit me with a late fee but I paid on time. Can you write a reply disputing it? Keep it firm but polite.
final_prompt:
My landlord hit me with a late fee but I paid on time. Can you write a reply disputing it? Keep it firm but polite.

<document>
From: Dana Whitfield, Maple Court Apartments
Subject: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi,

Our records show this month's rent was received on the 3rd. As you know, rent is due
on the 1st, so a late fee of $75 has been added to your account. We were disappointed
to see this, since on-time payments help us keep the building running for everyone.
We'd appreciate it if you could be more careful going forward. Please pay the fee
along with next month's rent.

Thanks for understanding,
Dana

---
Lease excerpt (Maple Court residential lease):
Section 4.1: Rent is $1,450 per month, payable by check, money order, or the resident
portal.
Section 4.2: Rent is due on the 1st. A grace period applies through the 5th; no late
fees may be charged during the grace period.
Section 4.3: Returned payments incur a $35 fee.
Section 9.4: Notices to the landlord must be in writing and may be sent by email.
</document>

Subject: Re: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi Dana,

Thank you for your message. I'm writing to dispute the $75 late fee on my account for this month.

My rent payment was received on the 3rd, which falls within the grace period described in Section 4.2 of my lease. That section states that no late fees may be charged during the grace period, which runs through the 5th. Because the payment was made within that window, the late fee does not appear to be permitted under the lease.

I'd ask that you reverse the $75 charge and update my account accordingly. Please confirm in writing once this has been done. If you believe I'm reading the lease incorrectly, I'd appreciate it if you could point me to the specific language that applies.

I value my tenancy at Maple Court and want to keep my payments on track, so I appreciate your attention to this.

Thank you,
[Your name]
Unit 3B

---
